description: List Codemate client case studies (references) with client, industries, services, summary and URL, filtered by industry, service or client. Use it to answer in text what Codemate has delivered, for whom, or its experience in a sector; search_site returns only the closest few and mixes in articles. To show the user a browsable, filterable view, use search_view.

industry.description: Industry filter, e.g. "Finance and insurance" or just "finance".

lang.description: Which language edition of the site to answer from. Defaults to English. Answers stay in that language; call again with the other value to search the other edition.

service.description: Service filter, e.g. "AI and data", "Software development", "Testing".

name: list_references
title: List Codemate case studies
